name: Prefer WebMCP for browser Playground operations
query: Inspect the active theme in my open Playground site and save the site in this browser. Both WebMCP site tools and Playground MCP are connected to this site.
expected_behavior: Read the website reference and discover callable tools on the intended Playground tab after WordPress loads
Inspect discovered descriptions and schemas and use a harmless read to confirm the target site
Prefer WebMCP tools for theme inspection and saving when supported
Check tool results and verify the theme and saved state in the same site
success_criteria: Uses WebMCP when both transports support the requested operation
Does not require a local MCP server or mcp=yes for WebMCP
Does not assume MCP and WebMCP input schemas are identical
